LESSON: INTRODUCTION TO PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Foundations of Pre -Technical Studies
Topic 1.1: Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is Pre- Technical Studies important in day-to- day life?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the components of Pre-Technical Studies as a learning area
2. explain the role of Pre- Technical Studies in day- to-day life

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: INTRODUCTION TO PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
This lesson teaches Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies for Grade 7 PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify the components of Pre-Technical Studies as a learning area
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. explain the role of Pre- Technical Studies in day- to-day life
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies above.
2. Explain Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is Pre- Technical Studies important in day-to- day life?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the components of Pre-Technical Studies as a learning area
2. explain the role of Pre- Technical Studies in day- to-day life

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
